hero-description:
I declare that every mountain standing before me shall become a plain in Jesus’ name.

By the grace of God, every obstacle in my life is removed.

I receive strength and courage to overcome every challenge before me.

Every delay and limitation is broken by the power of God.

I declare victory over every situation that looks impossible.

Grace will complete every good work God has started in my life.

I walk in divine favor, breakthrough, and supernatural help today.
